name: io.github.khajapasha003/nextora-mcp
title: Nextora Insights FinOps & SaaS MCP
description: SaaS pricing across 548+ tools, GitHub repo FinOps audits, verified cloud deals & MCP App UI.

tools.name: open_nextora_workbench
tools.description: Open the interactive Nextora FinOps & Revenue Workbench UI (SaaS bill-slasher audit, live partner deals vault, tool comparator, and instant Razorpay/PayPal checkout). All arguments are optional.

manifest.description: Optional package.json or .env contents to audit immediately

tools.name: search_saas_tools
tools.description: Search 817 curated developer, AI, cloud, and productivity tools with pricing evidence, active partner coupons, and tracked /go links.

query.description: Keyword or capability (e.g. 'vector database', 'ai code editor', 'auth', 'vps')

limit.description: Max results (default 10; up to 50 with Bearer nx_pro_ token)

tools.name: get_tool_details
tools.description: Retrieve verified pricing tiers, feature specs, active coupon deals, and founder claim URL for a tool by slug.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare two software tools side-by-side on pricing, active partner deals, and architectural trade-offs.

tools.name: calculate_stack_cost
tools.description: Calculate monthly and annual team SaaS TCO across selected tool slugs with deterministic billing math.

volumeUnits.description: Optional volume count for tiered tools

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all 8 canonical software verticals with live tool counts on Nextora Insights.

tools.name: get_verified_deals
tools.description: Fetch verified $500+ cloud credits, trials, and active promo codes (Hostinger, Railway, Baremetrics prioritized) filtered by category or keyword.

tools.name: audit_stack_savings
tools.description: Scan raw package.json, .env keys, docker-compose, or stack text to detect SaaS overspend and recommend tracked alternatives. Free tier shows top 2 findings; Bearer nx_pro_ unlocks all findings.

manifest.description: Contents of package.json, .env, or comma-separated tool names

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Generate a live Razorpay (INR) or PayPal (USD) checkout payment URL with active seasonal promo pricing and optional 30% partner referral attribution (partnerRef) for DevPass, Verified Vendor, Sponsored Leader, Newsletter Sponsor, Comparison Sponsor, or Enterprise Audit.

rail.description: Payment rail (razorpay for INR/UPI/Cards, paypal for USD/Cards)

email.description: Buyer or founder email for receipt & token delivery

slug.description: Optional product or /vs/ slug for vendor badges/sponsorships

promoCode.description: Optional seasonal promo code (auto-applies active promo if omitted)

partnerRef.description: Optional 30% partner handle (?ref=<code>) to credit recurring commission on settlement

tools.name: submit_saas_listing
tools.description: Submit a software product or AI tool directly from your IDE into Nextora Insights directory and receive embed badge HTML plus optional 24h Fast-Track checkout URL.

tools.name: audit_github_repo
tools.description: SSRF-safely scan any public GitHub repository (owner/repo) to compute its SaaS & cloud FinOps Grade (A+–F), annual savings, live Hostinger/Railway/Baremetrics switch links, README SVG badge Markdown, and DevPass/Enterprise Audit links.

repo.description: Public GitHub repo in 'owner/repo' or 'https://github.com/owner/repo' format (e.g. 'calcom/cal.com')

seats.description: Team size for SaaS cost modeling (default 10)

tools.name: get_sponsor_inventory
tools.description: Inspect live active B2B sponsors and open self-serve sponsorship inventory across /vs/ comparisons, /deals, /best/, and Weekly Newsletter with real-time seasonal discounted USD/INR pricing.

slug.description: Optional comparison or tool slug filter

tools.name: register_partner_affiliate
tools.description: Self-serve enrollment into Nextora's 30% cash commission partner network for creators, agencies, newsletters, and autonomous AI agents. Returns instant ?ref=<code> links and private stats token.

name.description: Partner, creator, or agent brand name

email.description: Partner email for dashboard credentials & payouts

payoutAddress.description: Optional UPI ID, PayPal email, or Wise handle

website.description: Optional website, GitHub, or newsletter URL

tools.name: watch_saas_renewal
tools.description: Enroll a SaaS tool into Nextora's automated price-hike & 30-day pre-renewal watchdog so teams get automatic lower-cost switch alerts before auto-renewal.

email.description: Work email to receive renewal alerts & alternatives dossier

toolName.description: Optional display name of the tool

tools.name: app_search_tools
tools.description: App-only live catalogue search for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_get_verified_deals
tools.description: App-only verified deals fetcher for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_audit_stack_savings
tools.description: App-only FinOps manifest scanner for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_compare_tools
tools.description: App-only side-by-side comparison for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_calculate_stack
tools.description: App-only stack TCO calculator for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_create_checkout_link
tools.description: App-only Razorpay/PayPal checkout link generator for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_submit_saas_listing
tools.description: App-only founder listing submission for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_audit_github_repo
tools.description: App-only public GitHub repo FinOps grader for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_get_sponsor_inventory
tools.description: App-only live B2B sponsor inventory loader for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_register_partner_affiliate
tools.description: App-only 30% cash partner signup for the Nextora Workbench UI.

tools.name: app_watch_saas_renewal
tools.description: App-only SaaS renewal watchdog subscriber for the Nextora Workbench UI.
